name: MyDeputy AI Chat & Booking
author: MyDeputy

sections.description:
MyDeputy is an Enterprise AI Chatbot platform and Smart Booking Terminal trained exclusively on your business data.
Transform your WordPress or WooCommerce store with a smart widget that can converse with your visitors in 95+ languages, answer complex questions, and handle bookings and lead generation 24/7.

Features

  • Train via Messengers: AI learns exclusively from your data. Simply send an image, voice memo, or PDF via connected WhatsApp or Telegram — the system will instantly process it, making your chatbot’s knowledge base ready to share.
  • Smart Booking Terminal: A real-time booking system for any business. Receive instant orders on your shared Terminal (unlimited staff), or directly via WhatsApp, Telegram, and Email for lightning-fast notifications.
  • Instant Booking & Forms: When a customer makes a booking via the chatbot or Action Button, the reservation instantly appears on your team’s tablet and messengers.
  • Multi-Language Support: Automatically detects and speaks 95+ languages.
  • WooCommerce Synchronization: Seamlessly integrates with your store to recommend products.

External services

This plugin connects to the MyDeputy cloud service to provide AI chat, booking, and dashboard features.

Service endpoints used by the plugin:
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/webhook/installed
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/webhook/uninstalled
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/static/js/chat-loader.js
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/dashboard
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/bootstrap
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/widget/settings
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/set_category
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/api/stats
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/wp/auth_transfer
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/start-analyze-task
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/analyze-task-status
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/start-parsing
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/parsing-status
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/split-large-chunks
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/regenerate-embeddings
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/start-extraction-task
* https://mydeputy.co.uk/dashboard/api/extraction-task-status

Data sent to the service:
* Site URL and domain
* Generated site token
* Administrator email address
* Site name
* Plugin version
* Business category and widget-enable updates made by the administrator in the embedded mini dashboard
* Quick Start request payloads (selected pages / website URL) and task progress lookups requested by the administrator
* Visitor-provided chat messages and booking form details (only when a visitor interacts with the widget)
* On mini-dashboard load, site domain and site token are sent in the WordPress bootstrap request to validate the installation and create a secure server session

When data is sent:
* Only after an administrator explicitly enables “External services consent” in plugin settings and clicks “Connect MyDeputy”.
* When the frontend widget is enabled, the site loads MyDeputy chat-loader.js and sends only the domain as the “shop” parameter.
* When an administrator opens the MyDeputy mini dashboard in WordPress Admin, the plugin loads local dashboard assets from this plugin package, requests WordPress bootstrap JSON/session data from MyDeputy, and forwards dashboard API requests through a secure WordPress admin proxy.
* When an administrator uses widget toggle, category selection, quick-start setup, or progress checks in the embedded mini dashboard.
* When an administrator clicks “Preview Widget”, the plugin opens your hosted widget preview URL (/w/{widget_token}).
* When a visitor sends a chat message or submits a booking request through the widget, that request data is sent to MyDeputy to provide the requested functionality.
* When an administrator chooses “Full Dashboard” from inside the embedded page, the plugin requests a secure transfer and opens the MyDeputy dashboard route.
* On plugin deactivation, site URL and site token are sent to deactivate the installation remotely.

Service privacy policy: https://mydeputy.co.uk/privacy
Service terms of use: https://mydeputy.co.uk/terms
Service pricing: https://mydeputy.co.uk/pricing
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the “MyDeputy” menu in your WordPress Admin to access your dashboard.
  4. Review the External Services section, enable consent, and save settings.
  5. Click “Connect MyDeputy” to create or link your MyDeputy account.
  6. Enable or disable the frontend widget from the same settings page.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

This plugin is a connector to the MyDeputy cloud service. New MyDeputy accounts receive a 14-day free trial in the service, and after the trial you can choose a paid service plan. The plugin code distributed on WordPress.org is fully available.

Is this trialware?

No. This plugin connects WordPress to an external SaaS platform (MyDeputy). Billing applies to the cloud service plan after the optional trial period, not to locked premium code inside this plugin.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The AI widget can process your store’s products and help users find what they are looking for.

Does the plugin track users by default?

No. External services remain disabled until an administrator explicitly enables consent and connects the site.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fixed plugin review issues: Replaced inline admin dashboard style/script usage with local assets via wp_enqueue_style() and wp_enqueue_script().
  • Fixed plugin review issues: Replaced non-sanitizing filter_input usage and added strict sanitization/validation for all proxy inputs.
  • Added explicit external-service consent flow in admin settings.
  • Added Connect/Disconnect controls for MyDeputy cloud service.
  • Frontend widget now loads only when consent is enabled, site is connected, and widget is enabled.
  • Added full external-service data disclosure and policy links in readme.txt and admin UI.
  • Replaced iframe dashboard embedding with native wp-admin mini-dashboard rendering.
  • Added secure dashboard session transfer flow for opening Full Dashboard from embedded admin UI.
  • Admin mini dashboard is now rendered from local plugin files and uses API/bootstrap calls only.
  • Improved WordPress sandbox compatibility for admin-ajax routing and dashboard proxy requests.
  • Replaced all inline style=”…” attributes in the admin settings panel with proper CSS classes.
  • Added esc_url() and esc_html() escaping for all hardcoded external URLs in admin page output.
  • Quick Start now auto-refreshes the page after completion to show final synced status.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
